note: The feature list. Every feature carries exactly three things: the observable behavior, the verification command that proves it, and the current state. Only a passing verification command may set `done` — an agent that types `state: done` without evidence is rejected by `doctor`. Granularity is calibrated to 'completable in one session'.

features.behavior: Both CLIs resolve .agents paths and configuration through one module, and vocabulary lives in contracts/ rather than being retyped in a CLI.
features.evidence: scripts/deep-learn.test.mjs asserts RESEARCH_STATUSES is imported, not retyped; .agents/lib/harness.mjs is the single config loader.

features.behavior: Every key in .agents/config.json is read by code, and the config-consumer check ignores archived history so a preserved snapshot cannot mask a dead key.
features.evidence: scripts/deep-learn.test.mjs 'doctor excludes archived history from the config-consumer scan'; doctor reports 0 config warnings.

features.behavior: UNVERIFIED, NOT EXECUTED, and TESTED are legal in strict validation; version honesty is enforced on the topic's own versions field instead of by banning a word.
features.evidence: scripts/deep-learn.test.mjs 'strict validation accepts honest execution labels'; requireVersionVerification checks frontmatter versions.

features.behavior: A deliberately broken cross-layer dependency is recorded in .agents/state/exceptions.json with reason, decider, and review date, so doctor stops reporting it as an unknown failure.
features.evidence: doctor reports the mcp-research-deleted exception for both targets with a 2026-11-01 review date.

features.behavior: deep-learn new writes docs/<slug>/learning.md containing objectives, concepts, a multi-page plan, and one assessment per objective, so no topic can be published as an unplanned single page.
features.evidence: scripts/deep-learn.test.mjs 'new writes a multi-page learning design file'; requireLearningDesignFile is enforced in strict validation.

features.behavior: docs/<slug>/review/ is agent output, so running review-learning cannot invalidate the topic's coverage map.
features.evidence: scripts/deep-learn-visual.test.mjs 'a review report does not invalidate the coverage map'.

features.behavior: Every objective in a topic's learning design resolves to an assessment on a published page, reported as a coverage ratio rather than assumed.
features.evidence: requireObjectiveAssessmentCoverage enforces it; visual validate --json reports objectiveCoverage.

features.behavior: Every skill declares its invocation mode, ships interface metadata, keeps a short front-loaded description, and appears in the AGENTS.md router.
features.evidence: doctor validates invocation, description length, openai.yaml, and router coverage; 9 skills pass.

features.behavior: harness.mjs reports VCR for the feature list and writes a machine-readable receipt naming the commit, commands, and exit codes for a topic.
features.evidence: scripts/harness.test.mjs covers VCR math, the no-evidence rejection, and receipt writing.

features.behavior: A single command runs static, runtime, and system checks in order and refuses to proceed past a failing layer.
features.evidence: node .agents/bin/harness.mjs check reports PASS for static, runtime, and system, with no SKIPPED layer. scripts/harness.test.mjs covers the skip-on-first-failure rule and the single-layer path.

features.behavior: Every push runs harness:check, npm test, and the production build, so a gate cannot be optional.
features.evidence: .github/workflows/harness.yml runs all three gates on push and pull_request.

features.behavior: verify-topic runs as a read-only subagent and writes per-objective verdicts to .agents/reviews/, so a verifier never edits what it verifies.
features.evidence: .agents/skills/verify-topic/SKILL.md with a read-only write scope and receipt requirement.

features.behavior: An ordinary question is answered in chat and creates no files, because an explicit no-write skill removes the temptation to scaffold a research package.
features.evidence: .agents/skills/explain/SKILL.md is user-invoked with a zero-file done condition.

features.behavior: The MCP lesson becomes one overview plus focused child pages with stable routes, shared topicId, and unique pageIds.
features.blocked_by: docs/model-context-protocol/ is deleted as pre-existing user work and must not be restored without confirmation. The page predates the multi-page contract and still uses the legacy single-page shape.

features.behavior: A validated research topic publishes as one overview plus focused child pages, with a learning design, a full coverage map, and complete objective coverage.
features.evidence: 8 pages published (overview, 3 modules, 1 deep-dive, practice, review), 218 coverage rows over 218 research sections, objective coverage 5/5. The production build renders 63 pages.

features.behavior: Learner progress is one browser-local store keyed from config, reports recorded answers rather than a mastery state, and says so when storage is unavailable.
features.evidence: scripts/progress-store.test.mjs asserts the storage key matches config, that no component touches localStorage directly, that a corrupt or full store fails soft, and that the fixed 1/3/7/21 schedule is not adaptive.
